paragraphs: Yochanan, scribe of Rabban Gamliel [the Elder].

[Sanhedrin 11b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.11b.2-3) relates that Rabban Gamliel was sitting on a step on the Temple Mount, with Yochanan the scribe standing before him: “Take one letter and write,” etc. [Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 5:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Maaser_Sheni.5.4.3) reads Yochanan the Priest, the scribe.

notes.text: The Elder is bracketed in Hyman’s heading. In the Bavli the scribe is standing before Rabban Gamliel. The Jerusalem Talmud adds “the priest” and has him seated before Rabban Gamliel and the elders. The [Tosefta parallel](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Sanhedrin.2.2) also includes the elders and has the scribe walk in front of them.
